map.按结构校验 IMSI（国际移动用户标识）的前缀与位数，提示 MCC/MNC 含义: Structurally validate the prefix and digit count of the IMSI (International Mobile Subscriber Identity), explain MCC/MNC meaning, for telecom data verification; pure front-end check, no network.
map.IMSI = MCC(3 位) + MNC(2~3 位) + MSIN，总长 1: IMSI = MCC (3 digits) + MNC (2–3 digits) + MSIN, total 14–15 digits
map.依据 3GPP 规范校验 IMSI 的前缀与长度，并解析 MCC（国家码）与 M: Per the 3GPP spec, validate the prefix and length of the IMSI and parse the meaning of MCC (country code) and MNC (network code); for telecom data verification, pure front-end, no network.
map.按结构校验 IMSI 的 MCC/MNC 前缀与位数: Structurally validate the IMSI MCC/MNC prefix and digit count
map.通信数据核验时识别归属国家与运营商: Identify the home country and operator during telecom data verification
map.输入以 460 开头的 15 位 IMSI，页面提示 MCC=460（中国）并解: Enter a 15-digit IMSI starting with 460; the page shows MCC=460 (China) and parses the MNC and MSIN segments, to judge the card's operator.
map.IMSI 的结构是什么？: What is the structure of an IMSI?
map.最多 15 位：前 3 位 MCC（国家码）+2–3 位 MNC（运营商码）+M: Up to 15 digits: first 3 MCC (country code) + 2–3 MNC (operator code) + MSIN (subscriber id); the page parses and explains MCC/MNC meaning.
map.IMSI 和手机号（MSISDN）有什么区别？: What is the difference between IMSI and a phone number (MSISDN)?
map.IMSI 是 SIM 卡内部标识，不对外显示；MSISDN 是用户拨打的手机号，: IMSI is the internal SIM identifier, not shown externally; MSISDN is the dialed phone number, and the two can be separated when roaming.
map.校验通过代表卡可用吗？: Does passing validation mean the card is usable?
map.不代表。页面只校验结构，卡片状态与归属须由运营商确认。: No. The page only checks structure; card status and ownership must be confirmed by the operator.
